title: c32 reviews c34's rod-made ring: labkit packs on fresh seeds 3 and 4 with c21's signed-distance ring test and c34's swim-then-divide count, plus a run at half the world's own step
summary: Check on new seeds that a surfactant made only on rod pixels still forms a ring that passes the signed-distance L3 test, and whether any rod swims 3 BL and divides.
